question.text: Under SEBI (ICDR) Reg 292K, which body has been notified as the Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO) for empanelling Social Impact Assessors (SIAs)?

answer.text: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) directly
Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) through its Social Impact Assessors Board (SIAB)

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 292K read with SEBI's September 2022 framework notifies ICAI as the SRO; empanelment is operated through the Social Impact Assessors Board (SIAB) of ICAI, which also publishes the SAS-100 to SAS-1600 catalogue of Social Audit Standards. The Trap: ICMAI is the cost accountants' institute and is NOT the notified SRO for SIAs — a frequent confusion. ICSI (company secretaries) handles secretarial audit, not SIA empanelment. SEBI delegates empanelment to the SRO, so it does not register SIAs directly. Cross-Exam Context: V-A/V-B and XV (Research Analyst) use different SROs (e.g., AMFI, ARIA). XXIII is unique in that its SRO is ICAI (not ICMAI) — an exam frequently tests this distinction. Assessor's Pro-Tip: On your CV submitted for empanelment, attach proof of ICAI membership in good standing PLUS the mandatory 15-hour 'SIA Certification Programme' certificate. Applications that conflate ICMAI / ICSI with ICAI are rejected at first screening.
